The chart is a line graph that compares the F1分数 (F1 score) of three different models, lattice, FLAT, and OURS, over a range of epoch values. The x-axis is labeled "epoch (次)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 18, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "F1分数" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05.

The lattice model is represented by a red line with square markers, which starts at approximately 0.59 at epoch 2 and increases to around 0.87 at epoch 16. The FLAT model is represented by a blue line with circular markers, which starts at approximately 0.78 at epoch 2 and increases to around 0.89 at epoch 16. The OURS model is represented by a yellow line with triangular markers, which starts at approximately 0.81 at epoch 4 and increases to around 0.91 at epoch 16.
